'''Duff Caros''', also known as '''Stumpy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who ran the [[Sleeping Rancor]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Nuba City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. By the War, Caros used a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] platform to move around as he lacked legs. His cantina was operated mostly by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and served water-down drinks to its customers. At one stage during the war, while Caros was working at the cantina a pair of patrons working for the droid manufacturer [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] attempted to plant a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] belonging to their employer's rival, [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], onto another patron at the bar. A pair of Industrial Automaton security personnel then arrived looking for the card and a fight ensued. During the fight one of the Cybot Galactica employees, [[Brom (thug)|Brom]], shot a sleeping [[Ronto/Legends|Ronto]] outside the cantina, which then when on rampage, causing significant damage to Caros's building.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Duff Caros first appeared in "[[A Quick Stopover]]" an adventure module in the [[2014]] ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' sourcebook for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system. The module gives a number of options as to how the fight in the cantina proceeds, favoring no one outcome, and so this article makes no assumptions as to how it plays out.
